a: A blockchain is a distributed ledger of blocks linked by cryptographic hashes.
A smart contract is code that runs on a blockchain and enforces rules automatically.
Ethereum is a blockchain platform for smart contracts and decentralized apps.
Gas is the fee paid to execute operations on networks like Ethereum.
A crypto wallet holds keys that control blockchain addresses and assets.
A private key must stay secret; it authorizes transactions from an address.
An NFT is a unique token on a blockchain representing ownership of a digital item.
DeFi is decentralized finance — lending, trading, and more without traditional banks.
Consensus mechanisms (PoW, PoS) agree on the valid chain state across nodes.
Solidity is the main language for Ethereum smart contracts.
